#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
run_dir="$base/run"
pidfile="$run_dir/worker.pid"
worker="$base/worker.py"
lockfile="$run_dir/control.lock"

mkdir -p "$run_dir"
exec 9>"$lockfile"
flock -x 9

inspect_pid()
{
    pid=
    state=missing

    [ -f "$pidfile" ] || return 0

    IFS= read -r pid < "$pidfile" || pid=
    case "$pid" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*|0)
            state=stale
            return 0
            ;;
    esac

    if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
        state=stale
        return 0
    fi

    if [ -r "/proc/$pid/cmdline" ] &&
       tr '\000' '\n' < "/proc/$pid/cmdline" 2>/dev/null |
           grep -Fqx -- "$worker"; then
        state=worker
    else
        state=foreign
    fi
}

start_worker()
{
    inspect_pid
    case "$state" in
        worker)
            printf 'worker already running (pid %s)\n' "$pid"
            return 0
            ;;
        stale)
            printf 'removing stale pid file (pid %s)\n' "${pid:-invalid}"
            rm -f -- "$pidfile"
            ;;
        foreign)
            printf 'pid %s belongs to another process; replacing pid file only\n' "$pid"
            rm -f -- "$pidfile"
            ;;
        missing)
            ;;
    esac

    python "$worker" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    new_pid=$!
    printf '%s\n' "$new_pid" > "$pidfile"

    if ! kill -0 "$new_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
        rm -f -- "$pidfile"
        printf 'worker failed to start\n' >&2
        return 1
    fi

    printf 'worker started (pid %s)\n' "$new_pid"
}

stop_worker()
{
    inspect_pid
    case "$state" in
        missing)
            printf 'worker not running\n'
            return 0
            ;;
        stale)
            printf 'removed stale pid file (pid %s)\n' "${pid:-invalid}"
            rm -f -- "$pidfile"
            return 0
            ;;
        foreign)
            printf 'pid %s belongs to another process; not stopping it\n' "$pid"
            rm -f -- "$pidfile"
            return 0
            ;;
        worker)
            kill "$pid"
            attempts=0
            while kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; do
                if [ ! -r "/proc/$pid/cmdline" ] ||

                       grep -Fqx -- "$worker"; then
                    break
                fi
                attempts=$((attempts + 1))
                if [ "$attempts" -ge 50 ]; then
                    printf 'worker did not stop (pid %s)\n' "$pid" >&2
                    return 1
                fi
                sleep 0.1
            done
            rm -f -- "$pidfile"
            printf 'worker stopped (pid %s)\n' "$pid"
            ;;
    esac
}

status_worker()
{
    inspect_pid
    case "$state" in
        missing)
            printf 'worker stopped (no pid file)\n'
            return 1
            ;;
        stale)
            printf 'stale pid file (pid %s)\n' "${pid:-invalid}"
            return 1
            ;;
        foreign)
            printf 'pid file refers to another process (pid %s)\n' "$pid"
            return 3
            ;;
        worker)
            printf 'worker running (pid %s)\n' "$pid"
            return 0
            ;;
    esac
}

case "${1:-}" in
